title: Videos
tagline: Describe the film; watch the shots arrive on the canvas.
description: Say what you want to see and the agent plans the shots, renders each one, lays them out on a canvas you can rearrange, and assembles them into a single video you can download. Clips render in the background, so you keep working while they come in.

harness.name: Videos

$comment: This kit generates media, so launch provisions the entry that reaches the media server
this deployment hosts. Unlike the database kit it collects NOTHING from the person:
the provider credential belongs to this deployment's integrations and never becomes a
per-harness secret, so the record holds only the binding and the key stays behind the
server. The key here is the server's name, not the kit's — one server, and other kits
may reach the same one later.
harness.mcp_servers is the wrong place for this: a literal url written there is wrong
the moment this deployment's address differs from the one it was written on.
media.name: media

harness.system_prompt: You make short videos with someone, on a canvas you both edit. Read the video-storyboard Skill first, on every request, and follow it: the rules that make this app work travel with the Skill.

session.$comment: One session is one video. The app lists this harness's sessions as the video list.
